models.name: consensus
models.full-name: Shared coin protocol from the randomised consensus algorithm of Aspnes and Herlihy

properties.name: c2
properties.description: Minimum probability that the protocol finishes with all coins equal to v=1

properties.name: disagree
properties.description: Maximum probability of finishing protocol with coins not all equal

properties.name: c1
properties.description: With probability 1, all processes finish the protocol

properties.name: steps_max
properties.description: Maximum expected steps to finish

properties.name: steps_min
properties.description: Minimum expected steps to finish

models.name: csma
models.full-name: IEEE 802.3 CSMA/CD (Carrier Sense, Multiple Access with Collision Detection) protocol

properties.name: all_before_max
properties.description: Maximum probability all stations send successfully before a collision with max backoff

properties.name: all_before_min
properties.description: Minimum probability all stations send successfully before a collision with max backoff

properties.name: some_before
properties.description: Minimum probability that some station eventually delivers with less than K backoffs

properties.name: time_max
properties.description: Maximum expected time for all messages to be sent

properties.name: time_min
properties.description: Minimum expected time for all messages to be sent

models.name: firewire

params.name: delay
params.description: maximum wire transmission delay, in units of 10ns

models.notes: PTA model from [KNS03b] based on TA model from [SS01].

properties.name: elected
properties.description: A leader is always eventually elected with probability 1

properties.name: time_max
properties.description: Maximum expected time to elect a leader

properties.name: time_min
properties.description: Minimum expected time to elect a leader

properties.name: time_sending
properties.description: Maximum expected time spent sending before electing a leader

params.description: maximum wire transmission delay, in units of 10ns

properties.name: elected
properties.description: A leader is always eventually elected with probability 1

properties.name: rounds

models.name: firewire_impl_dl
models.full-name: IEEE 1394 FireWire root contention protocol (with timer for deadline properties)

params.name: delay
params.description: maximum wire transmission delay, in units of 10ns

properties.name: deadline

properties.name: cost_min
properties.description: Minimum expected cost for both stations to send correctly
